notes: The dash gloss «قال أبو غسان حدثنا معاذ بن هشام» names the same man: one link (rule 7).
«حدثني أبي» with no name is a relation (rule 7).
«أن عمر بن الخطاب ... جعل يسب» is a described scene; Umar's words sit inside it, while the relayed saying is the Prophet's act, so Umar is not added (rule 6). Jabir is the last link.
